Reach, no register

Attention that doesn't become revenue

All 7 of your last 7 reels cleared 2k views on an 11k audience. When a reel lands, the next step is a free guide or class, so nothing turns that attention into income on the day.

The jump

From free to $1,200 in one step

Someone who loves the podcast but isn't ready for a 10-week programme has nothing to say yes to in between. They stay on the list, and you can't tell how serious they are.

Off the path

Good products in the wrong place

The $49 Game Planner and the Blueprint already exist, but they live in the store and on their own pages, not at the moment someone has just finished learning from you.

No buyer signal

Sign-ups show interest, not intent

Free classes, challenges and quizzes build your list. A purchase is what shows your four coaches who is ready for personal support.

Your content and your free class do their job. What's missing is a first purchase that pays for ads and shows you who is ready for Restore and 1:1.

Questions

Before you start

Is this medical advice?

No. It's education: lessons, a guide and a workbook to help you understand the topic and have better conversations with your doctor. It isn't medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.

Will the kit tell me what's going on with my body?

No education product can do that. The kit explains the common factors and helps you ask better questions. For personal support, you can apply for coaching with our team.

I've watched your free masterclass. Is this different?

Yes. The masterclass is an overview. The kit gives you the lessons to revisit, the appointment prep guide and the tracking workbook to actually use.

How much time does it take?

Each lesson is short. Watch one a day or all in one sitting, and come back to them whenever you like.

What happens after the kit?

If you want to go deeper, the Restore Your Fertility Blueprint is our self-paced programme, and you can apply for Restore Live group coaching or 1:1 coaching.

Ad creatives · Video scripts · Meta

Ad scripts: hook, body, CTA

Three talking-to-camera scripts, each 30 to 45 seconds, in the style of your reels. Every video ends with the on-screen line: “Educational content, not medical advice.” No outcome promises, and no lines that assume anything about the viewer's health.

Script 1 · “The question we get every day”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“There are four of us, and we get the same question every single day.”

Body

“Why do periods go missing? The honest answer is that it's rarely one thing. So we put our explanation into five short lessons: the common causes, what normal labs do and don't tell you, how cycle tracking works, and the stress and mindset side nobody talks about.”

CTA

“The Cycle Clarity Kit. Five lessons, $27. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: the three of you to camera against a cream wall, in your neutral outfits, terracotta caption bars.

Script 2 · “Walk in prepared”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Doctor's appointments go fast. Here's how to walk in prepared.”

Body

“Write your questions down before you go. Bring your cycle notes. Ask what a result does and doesn't rule out. Our Cycle Clarity Kit has a full appointment prep guide with the questions we'd bring, plus a short lesson on reading what you're told.”

CTA

“The Cycle Clarity Kit. Self-paced, $27. Tap the button below.”

Shot: Dani to camera, cut to the prep guide on a phone, each question appearing as an on-screen checklist.

Script 3 · “BS investigators”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“We call ourselves BS investigators. Here's why.”

Body

“There's a lot of noise online about cycles and hormones. Our job is to cut through it and find the real issue. We host The Hypothalamic Amenorrhea Podcast, and our new kit is the plain-English version of what we explain every week: five short lessons, a prep guide and a tracking workbook.”

CTA

“The Cycle Clarity Kit, $27. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: walking-and-talking, magnifying glass sticker on screen, the words “find the real issue” highlighted in terracotta.
